name: stremio
title: Stremio
description: Search movies & series, browse catalogs and control the Stremio app running on this computer
author: Kxrbx

commands.name: search-stremio
commands.title: Search Movies & Series
commands.description: Search movies and series and open them directly in Stremio

commands.name: browse-stremio
commands.title: Browse Catalogs
commands.description: Browse popular, new and featured movies & series from your Stremio catalogs

commands.name: quick-navigation
commands.title: Quick Navigation
commands.description: Jump straight to Board, Library, Discover, Calendar or Addons in Stremio, or open a search query in it

commands.name: stremio-status
commands.title: Server Status
commands.description: Show the connection status of the local Stremio streaming server

preferences.name: serverHost
preferences.title: Streaming Server Host
preferences.description: Host of the Stremio streaming server running on this computer.

preferences.name: serverPort
preferences.title: Streaming Server Port
preferences.description: Port of the Stremio streaming server running on this computer.

preferences.name: defaultContentType
preferences.title: Default Content Type
preferences.description: Content type selected by default when searching and browsing.

preferences.name: galleryColumns
preferences.title: Gallery Columns
preferences.description: Number of poster columns displayed in the catalog gallery.

preferences.name: preferredPlayer
preferences.title: Preferred Player
preferences.description: Video player used to play Stremio streams directly from Raycast.

preferences.name: customPlayerPath
preferences.title: Custom Player Path
preferences.description: Path to the player executable, used when Preferred Player is set to Custom.

preferences.name: playerArguments
preferences.title: Player Arguments
preferences.description: Extra arguments appended before the stream URL (e.g. --no-video-title-show).

preferences.name: primaryAction
preferences.title: Default Playback Action
preferences.description: Action performed when selecting a title or stream (Enter).

preferences.name: addonManifest1
preferences.title: Stream Addon 1
preferences.description: Manifest URL of a Stremio addon providing streams, e.g. https://my-addon.example.com/manifest.json

preferences.name: addonManifest2
preferences.title: Stream Addon 2
preferences.description: Manifest URL of an extra Stremio addon (catalogs and streams are merged with the built-ins).

preferences.name: addonManifest3
preferences.title: Stream Addon 3
preferences.description: Manifest URL of an extra Stremio addon (catalogs and streams are merged with the built-ins).

preferences.name: addonManifest4
preferences.title: Stream Addon 4
preferences.description: Manifest URL of an extra Stremio addon (catalogs and streams are merged with the built-ins).

preferences.name: addonManifests
preferences.title: More Addon Manifests (advanced)
preferences.description: Comma-separated manifest URLs, if you need more than the four slots above.
